    Get vehicles online

    Installation

    Pick your product below. Each one has an installation video, a click-through interactive guide (tick off each step as you go), and a verification checklist. Most devices are 15-minute plug-and-play — one installer can equip 3–4 vehicles an hour.

    AI Dashcams

    AD Plus 2.0Guide + checklist
    Installation video
    AD Plus 2.0 — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 6 steps
    1Insert storage & SIM
    Open the side cover. Insert up to two Micro SD cards (Class 10+, up to 1 TB each) and one industrial Nano SIM (MP2) — do not use a consumer MP1 SIM.
    2Choose a power method
    Connect the Power Box, then pick one: OBD plug-and-play (16-PIN or 9-PIN OBD power cable) for the fastest install, or the open-wire ACC cable (POWER, GND, ACC, CAN-H, CAN-L + sensor I/O) to hard-wire. 12 V / 24 V self-adaptive.
    3Mount on the windshield
    Wipe the glass with the alcohol pad, fit the camera to the bracket, and press it centred just below the rear-view mirror. Tighten with the hex wrench so the road-facing lens sits level.
    4Connect optional cameras / devices
    Use the video-output cable for an extra AHD camera, an IPC camera, or a display. R-Watch and iButton connect at the Power Box. Note: the AHD channel carries no audio and an external display can't preview the IPC channel.
    5Power on & set Wi-Fi
    Start the vehicle — the Power LED turns green. To put Wi-Fi into AP mode for local setup, press the Function button twice within 2 seconds.
    6Calibrate & verify
    Keep the vehicle stationary for ~3 minutes while ADAS auto-calibrates to the windshield angle. Then confirm livestream, GPS lock, and a test AI event in the CMS.
    Verification checklist
    AD MaxGuide + checklist
    Installation video
    AD Max — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 6 steps
    1Insert storage & SIM
    Insert the Micro SD card(s) (Class 10+) and an industrial Nano SIM.
    2Connect the Power Box
    Use OBD plug-and-play (16/9-PIN) for speed, or hard-wire the ACC cable (POWER / GND / ACC). 12/24 V self-adaptive.
    3Mount on the windshield
    Clean the glass, fit the bracket, and press the camera centred below the mirror. Level the road-facing lens.
    4Connect extra channels
    Attach any optional AHD/IPC camera or display via the video cable, if your configuration uses them.
    5Power on & set Wi-Fi
    Start the vehicle; the Power LED turns green. Double-press the function button to enter Wi-Fi AP mode for local setup.
    6Calibrate & verify
    Hold stationary ~3 min for ADAS auto-calibration, then verify livestream, GPS, and a test event in the CMS.
    Verification checklist

    DC MaxGuide + checklist
    Installation video
    DC Max — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Install the GT1 Pro first
    DC Max deploys only as a pair with the GT1 Pro gateway — power and data route through it. Install the gateway before the camera.
    2Insert storage & connect
    Insert the Micro SD card(s) and connect DC Max to the GT1 Pro per the supplied harness.
    3Mount on the windshield
    Clean the glass and press the camera centred below the mirror; level the lens.
    4Power on
    Start the vehicle and confirm the GT1 Pro gateway comes online on the platform.
    5Calibrate & verify
    Keep stationary ~3 min for ADAS calibration; verify all channels, GPS, and events in the CMS.
    Verification checklist

    Telematics Gateway

    GT1 ProGuide + checklist
    Installation video
    GT1 Pro — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Connect to the diagnostic port
    Locate the OBD-II / J1939 port and connect the GT1 Pro power+data harness.
    2Mount the gateway
    Fix it in a dry, vibration-stable spot under the dash with the supplied bracket.
    3Insert SIM & pair camera
    Insert the industrial SIM and connect the paired DC Max camera.
    4Power on & register
    Start the vehicle; confirm the gateway registers on the platform (currently USA market only).
    5Verify vehicle data
    Confirm speed, RPM, fuel, and fault-code data is flowing into the CMS.
    Verification checklist

    AD Plus 2.0 Accessories

    PBM (Power Box Max)Guide + checklist
    Installation video
    PBM (Power Box Max) — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Power down the dashcam
    Disconnect the AD Plus 2.0 from its standard power box.
    2Swap in the expansion box
    Replace the standard power box with the PBM (adds 2 channels + CAN) or PBP (adds CAN only).
    3Wire CAN
    Connect CAN-H / CAN-L to the vehicle bus (OBD-II / J1939) per the harness. For PBM, also connect the two extra cameras.
    4Reconnect & power on
    Reconnect to the AD Plus 2.0 and start the vehicle.
    5Verify
    Confirm CAN data (and the extra channels for PBM) appear in the CMS.
    Verification checklist

    MDVRs

    M1N 2.0Guide + checklist
    Installation video
    M1N 2.0 — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Mount the recorder
    Fix the MDVR in a secure, ventilated spot (under-seat / cabinet). Insert storage (SD/HDD per model).
    2Connect the cameras
    Wire each camera to its labelled channel (AHD/IPC), plus the DMS camera (C29N) and any aux cams (CA20S, C40W).
    3Wire power
    Connect ACC, +B (battery), and GND; add CAN / OBD if used.
    4Antennas & SIM
    Insert the SIM and connect the GPS and 4G antennas with a clear sky view.
    5Power on & verify
    Start the vehicle; confirm every channel shows video, GPS lock, and online status in the CMS.
    Verification checklist

    Visibility / BSD Cameras

    C53Guide + checklist
    Installation video
    C53 — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Mount the camera
    Fix the camera at the blind-spot position (side / rear) at the height given in the spec sheet.
    2Wire or link to host
    C53 (standalone): wire power + alarm output. C46 (IPC): connect to the MDVR via LAN/AHD.
    3Aim the lens
    Angle the lens to cover the target blind zone and lock the bracket.
    4Power on & configure
    Power on; for connected models, set the detection zone remotely (OTA).
    5Test detection
    Walk a person through the zone and confirm a BSD alert fires.
    Verification checklist

    Accessories

    C29NGuide + checklist
    Installation video
    C29N — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Mount on the A-pillar
    Mount the C29N on the A-pillar at the driver's eye level so the lens isn't blocked when the head dips forward.
    2Connect to the host
    Wire the C29N to the host's DMS/AHD input per the harness.
    3Aim at the driver
    Point at the driver's face; the 940 nm IR sees through sunglasses and works at 0 Lux, so a clear line of sight is all that's needed.
    4Power on
    Confirm the DMS channel appears in the CMS.
    5Test
    Cover the lens or simulate a look-away / yawn to trigger a DMS event.
    Verification checklist

    Asset Security

    Z5Guide + checklist
    Installation video
    Z5 — installation videoComing soon
    Interactive installation guide
    0 / 5 steps
    1Mount on the trailer
    Fix the Z5 with a view of the cargo door. It's standalone — its own cellular + GPS, independent of the tractor.
    2Connect power
    Connect to trailer power (or use its internal supply per model).
    3SIM & sky view
    Insert the SIM and ensure a clear sky view for GPS.
    4Power on
    Confirm the trailer appears on the map with a GPS fix.
    5Test door event
    Open the cargo door to confirm a door-open event and clip.
